msgs.text: Genera 5 imágenes separadas con Nano Banana 2.1, cada una en su formato y con su referencia (las referencias están adjuntas). Usa los textos tal cual, sin reescribirlos ni añadir nada. REGLA A: Use the EXACT garment(s) and accessories from the reference image: identical cut, length, fabric, colour, print, buttons, trims and details. Do not redesign, recolour or add garments. The model must be a completely different woman from anyone in the reference: a new face and a different hairstyle; never reproduce the face or likeness of a real person from the reference. If the reference is a mirror selfie, the new photo has no phone, no mirror and no selfie pose. Photorealistic, high-end commercial photography, natural skin texture, crisp material detail, no text, no letters, no watermark, no logos, no brand names, no frames, no collage, no words or labels anywhere in the image. REGLA B: Reproduce the EXACT product from the reference image: identical shape, proportions, materials, colours, stones and details; do not redesign it. Leave out any hands, price tags, stickers, shop text and the original background. Photorealistic, high-end commercial photography, natural skin texture, crisp material detail, no text, no letters, no watermark, no logos, no brand names, no frames, no collage, no words or labels anywhere in the image. IMAGEN 1 «h» (formato 16:9, referencia soul-feet-04.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): A stylish Spanish woman in her thirties wearing brown suede barefoot sneakers with a thin flexible gum sole, worn with cropped light jeans from the reference, walking at the seafront promenade of Benicàssim, Castellón, Spain, with palm trees, golden hour. One single continuous photograph, never a split screen, diptych, panel or collage. The subject stands in the right third of the frame and the same scene continues to the left, softly out of focus and calm, with room for a headline. Wide editorial campaign image, cinematic natural light. IMAGEN 2 «p1» (formato 3:4, referencia soul-feet-04.jpg, aplica la REGLA B): Footwear e-commerce photo of brown suede minimalist barefoot sneakers with a wide toe box and a thin gum sole, no logos from the reference, a pair shown at a three-quarter angle, centred and large in the frame on a seamless light (#EEE9E2) background with a soft floor shadow, crisp leather, suede and sole detail. IMAGEN 3 «p2» (formato 3:4, referencia soul-feet-11.jpg, aplica la REGLA B): Footwear e-commerce photo of navy leather barefoot sneakers with light blue laces and a thin gum sole, no logos from the reference, a pair shown at a three-quarter angle, centred and large in the frame on a seamless light (#EEE9E2) background with a soft floor shadow, crisp leather, suede and sole detail. IMAGEN 4 «p3» (formato 3:4, referencia soul-feet-12.jpg, aplica la REGLA B): Footwear e-commerce photo of dark brown leather tall barefoot boots with a flat flexible sole, no logos from the reference, a pair shown at a three-quarter angle, centred and large in the frame on a seamless light (#EEE9E2) background with a soft floor shadow, crisp leather, suede and sole detail. IMAGEN 5 «p4» (formato 3:4, referencia soul-feet-01.jpg, aplica la REGLA B): E-commerce product photo of a tan leather handbag with a sculpted tulip-shaped top and two short handles from the reference, centred and large in the frame on a seamless light (#EEE9E2) background with a soft shadow, crisp detail.
